<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <SunderPackageFamilyId>sunder.package.agent</SunderPackageFamilyId>
    <SunderPackageProject>true</SunderPackageProject>
    <SunderSdkWorkerReference>true</SunderSdkWorkerReference>
    <SunderSdkAvaloniaReference>true</SunderSdkAvaloniaReference>
    <SunderSdkStacksReference>true</SunderSdkStacksReference>
    <CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies>true</CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies>
    <SelfContained>false</SelfContained>
    <UseAppHost>false</UseAppHost>
    <PublishSingleFile>false</PublishSingleFile>
    <PublishTrimmed>false</PublishTrimmed>
    <EnableRuntimePackDownload>false</EnableRuntimePackDownload>
    <EnableAppHostPackDownload>false</EnableAppHostPackDownload>
    <RuntimeIdentifiers>win-x64;win-arm64;linux-x64;linux-arm64;osx-x64;osx-arm64</RuntimeIdentifiers>
    <AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault>true</AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault>
    <SunderAgentSharedTranscript>true</SunderAgentSharedTranscript>
    <SunderAgentCurrentPackageStorageKey>true</SunderAgentCurrentPackageStorageKey>
    <DefaultItemExcludes>$(DefaultItemExcludes);**/bin/**;**/obj/**</DefaultItemExcludes>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Data.Sqlite" SunderPackageAssetRole="worker" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Polly.Core" />
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia" />
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia.Controls.ItemsRepeater" />
    <PackageReference Include="CommunityToolkit.Mvvm" />
    <PackageReference Include="LiveMarkdown.Avalonia" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="..\Sunder.Package.Agent.Provider.Shared\Models\ProviderChatModels.cs"
             Link="Models\ProviderChatModels.cs" />
    <Compile Include="..\Sunder.Package.Agent.Shared\Execution\AgentExecutionFacetIds.cs"
             Link="Models\AgentExecutionFacetIds.cs" />
    <Compile Include="..\Sunder.Package.Agent.Shared\Storage\SqliteWalCheckpointMaintenance.cs"
             Link="Storage\SqliteWalCheckpointMaintenance.cs" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="Program.cs;PackageModule.cs;Runtime\AgentWorkerComposition.cs;App\PackageModule.cs;App\AppPackageModule.cs;**\*.Legacy.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="OwnerProtocol\**\*" />
    <None Remove="OwnerProtocol\**\*" />
    <AvaloniaResource Include="Assets\**" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <SunderSdkCapability Include="rpc.extended-deadline.v1" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <Import Project="..\Sunder.Package.Agent.Shared\Sunder.Package.Agent.Shared.props" />

</Project>

<Project>
  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderAgentCurrentPackageStorageKey)' == 'true'">
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)src/Sunder.Package.Agent.Shared/Storage/CurrentPackageStorageKey.cs"
             Link="Storage/CurrentPackageStorageKey.cs" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(IsTestProject)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)tests/Sunder.Package.Agent.TestAnalyzers/Sunder.Package.Agent.TestAnalyzers.csproj"
                      OutputItemType="Analyzer"
                      ReferenceOutputAssembly="false"
                      PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'worker' and '$(SunderPackagePrimaryProject)' == 'true' and '$(SunderPackageAppProject)' != '' and '$(SunderPackageInnerBuild)' != 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(SunderPackageAppProject)"
                      ReferenceOutputAssembly="false"
                      Private="false"
                      BuildReference="false"
                      PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'app'">
    <SunderPackageProject Condition="'$(SunderPackageProject)' == ''">true</SunderPackageProject>
    <SunderSdkAvaloniaReference Condition="'$(SunderSdkAvaloniaReference)' == ''">true</SunderSdkAvaloniaReference>
    <SunderPackageRuntimeIdentifiers>win-x64;win-arm64;linux-x64;linux-arm64;osx-x64;osx-arm64</SunderPackageRuntimeIdentifiers>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'protocol'">
    <SunderPackageProject Condition="'$(SunderPackageProject)' == ''">false</SunderPackageProject>
    <SunderSdkReference Condition="'$(SunderSdkReference)' == ''">true</SunderSdkReference>
    <SunderPackageBuildReference Condition="'$(SunderPackageBuildReference)' == ''">true</SunderPackageBuildReference>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="('$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' or '$(SunderSdkReference)' == 'true') and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(SunderSdkProject)"
                      GlobalPropertiesToRemove="Version;VersionPrefix;VersionSuffix;PackageVersion;InformationalVersion" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="('$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' or '$(SunderSdkReference)' == 'true') and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'false'">
    <PackageReference Include="Sunder.Sdk" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkStacksReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(SunderSdkStacksProject)"
                      GlobalPropertiesToRemove="Version;VersionPrefix;VersionSuffix;PackageVersion;InformationalVersion" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkStacksReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'false'">
    <PackageReference Include="Sunder.Sdk.Stacks" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkAvaloniaReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(SunderSdkAvaloniaProject)"
                      GlobalPropertiesToRemove="Version;VersionPrefix;VersionSuffix;PackageVersion;InformationalVersion" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkAvaloniaReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'false'">
    <PackageReference Include="Sunder.Sdk.Avalonia" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkWorkerReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="$(SunderSdkWorkerProject)"
                      GlobalPropertiesToRemove="Version;VersionPrefix;VersionSuffix;PackageVersion;InformationalVersion" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderSdkWorkerReference)' == 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'false'">
    <PackageReference Include="Sunder.Sdk.Worker" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="('$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' or '$(SunderPackageBuildReference)' == 'true') and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'false'">
    <PackageReference Include="Sunder.Package.Build" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' and '$(SunderPackageRole)' != ''">
    <SunderContractBundle Include="$([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName('$(SunderSdkStacksProject)'))\Contracts\sunder.stack.contributor.rpc.json" ContractId="sunder.stack.contributor" Version="2.0.0" DescriptorPath="contracts/sunder.stack.contributor.rpc.json" Exposure="public" Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and '$(SunderSdkStacksReference)' == 'true'" />

          BeforeTargets="_GenerateRestoreProjectPathWalk;CollectPackageReferences;PrepareForBuild">
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' != '' and '$(SunderPackageRole)' != 'worker' and '$(SunderPackageRole)' != 'app' and '$(SunderPackageRole)' != 'protocol' and '$(SunderPackageRole)' != 'test'"

           Text="SunderPackageFamilyId is required when SunderPackageRole is set." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'worker' and ('$(SunderPackageProject)' != 'true' or '$(SunderPackagePrimaryProject)' != 'true' or '$(SunderSdkWorkerReference)' != 'true')"
           Text="A worker role must be the primary package project and enable SunderPackageProject and SunderSdkWorkerReference." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'worker' and ('$(OutputType)' != 'Exe' or '$(SelfContained)' != 'false' or '$(UseAppHost)' != 'false' or '$(PublishSingleFile)' != 'false' or '$(PublishTrimmed)' != 'false')"
           Text="A worker role must be an untrimmed framework-dependent managed module without an apphost or single-file publish." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'worker' and ('$(CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies)' != 'true' or '$(RuntimeIdentifiers)' != 'win-x64;win-arm64;linux-x64;linux-arm64;osx-x64;osx-arm64' or '$(RuntimeIdentifier)' == '' or '$(SunderGeneratedPackageManifest)' == '')"
           Text="A worker role must use the shared six-RID thin-module output and generated-manifest defaults." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderPackageRole)' == 'protocol' and '$(SunderPackageProject)' != 'false'"
           Text="A protocol role must not be a runtime package project." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' != 'true' and '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' != 'false'"
           Text="SunderUseSourceSdk must be 'true' or 'false', but was '$(SunderUseSourceSdk)'." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and ('$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' or '$(SunderSdkReference)' == 'true') and !Exists('$(SunderSdkProject)')"
           Text="SunderUseSourceSdk is true, but the Sunder SDK project was not found at '$(SunderSdkProject)'." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and '$(SunderSdkStacksReference)' == 'true' and !Exists('$(SunderSdkStacksProject)')"
            Text="SunderUseSourceSdk is true, but the Sunder Stack SDK project was not found at '$(SunderSdkStacksProject)'." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and '$(SunderSdkAvaloniaReference)' == 'true' and !Exists('$(SunderSdkAvaloniaProject)')"
           Text="SunderUseSourceSdk is true, but the Sunder Avalonia SDK project was not found at '$(SunderSdkAvaloniaProject)'." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and '$(SunderSdkWorkerReference)' == 'true' and !Exists('$(SunderSdkWorkerProject)')"
           Text="SunderUseSourceSdk is true, but the Sunder Worker SDK project was not found at '$(SunderSdkWorkerProject)'." />
    <Error Condition="'$(SunderUseSourceSdk)' == 'true' and ('$(SunderPackageProject)' == 'true' or '$(SunderPackageBuildReference)' == 'true') and !Exists('$(SunderPackageBuildTargets)')"
            Text="SunderUseSourceSdk is true, but the Sunder package build targets were not found at '$(SunderPackageBuildTargets)'." />
  </Target>
